description: Choose how a listing you own earns a dofollow link (POST /api/agent/listing): sayabout, badge, or paid. `paid` returns a Dodo checkout URL whose metadata carries the submission id; the payment is verified server-side by the Dodo webhook. Nothing publishes or self-grants dofollow here.

path.description: Inclusion path. paid returns a Dodo checkout URL.

slug.description: Target a published tool you own (opens/reuses an upgrade request)

submissionId.description: Target a pending submission you own

verificationUrl.description: Required for sayabout (Wall of Love URL) / badge

name: upgrade_listing
